description: This file contains the implementation of the AdoNetClusteringTable class, which manages membership information for Orleans silos using an ADO.NET backend. It includes methods for reading, inserting, updating, and deleting membership entries, as well as initializing and cleaning up the membership table.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringTable
classes.description: Implementation of IMembershipTable that uses an ADO.NET database backend for Orleans cluster membership management.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the membership table, optionally creating the initial version row.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads the membership data for a given silo address.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry with associated table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry with a new ETag and table version.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a given membership entry.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a specified cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries of silos that are considered defunct before a specified date.
